method: Every numeric text span in the block was enumerated from the PDF text layer, then each was classified by reading a rendered crop (150-900 dpi) of the exact region. DIM = value printed on a dimension line between two terminators; LEADER = value on a leader/shelf or an elevation mark; OTHER = axis bubble, balloon/mark number, table cell, section tag.
